q: Can a CBAM verifier skip the site visit entirely?
title: Can a CBAM site visit be waived
short: Yes, but only after physical site visits in the two preceding reporting periods, and only if the other conditions for a virtual visit also hold. The Commission's guidance mentions very small and simple installations. The verifier must record its reasons and still reach reasonable assurance.
audience: Small Indian CBAM goods producers with simple, stable operations

ul: Physical visits in the two preceding reporting periods.
No significant change to the installation or monitoring plan.
Low risk and complexity, with all evidence available remotely.

p: The verifier still has to be satisfied the report is free from material misstatement, and can insist on a visit if evidence falls short.

senseible: Senseible keeps the invoices behind each fuel and electricity figure in one fingerprinted record, so a verifier can sample them without a hunt through files. Senseible is not a CBAM verifier and does not issue verification reports.
